notes: All 11 source and 14 target IDs partitioned exactly once; every head is a member of its array.

The two articles are treated differently on principle, not inconsistently: τήν governs an expressed noun the ASV left bare, so rule 23 empties it, while τά governs a substantival adjective and takes the supplied nominal 'gifts' under rules 49 and 102.

'Follow after' kept whole on Διώκετε: the object is accusative, which has no case for an English preposition to realize, so rule 106's accusative arm keeps the phrasal particle inside the verb's unit.
